notes: Encoded from Enviromaster's own page only. The page's sister/similar list (AIRCO, ARGO, Dunkirk, ECR, EMI, E-verter, Olsen, Oneida Royal, Pennco, RetroAire, Ultimate, Utica) is not stated to share this serial system, so no sisters are claimed and no usesStylesOf is set. Both styles' month letters are chart-only, so style 1 ships year + week and style 2 ships year-only.

styles.era: 14-character serials incl. dashes: digit + 2 digits + letter + 4 digits + 2 digits
styles.notes: Page example 1-99-C-9305-10; normalized form 199C930510. Year = 3rd-4th character numerical digits ('99' -> 1999; raw and digit-only counting agree). Month = 6th character letter (C), chart-only in image Style-1_EMI-Date-of-Manufacture_Serial-Number-Nomenclature.png, held for the image pass, so month is null. Week = last two numerical digits ('10').

styles.era: 11-character serials: 4 digits + letter + 6 digits, year only
styles.notes: Page positions 3-4 = year (normalized [2,4] -> '07' -> 2007); month = 5th character letter (A), chart-only in image Style-1_Airco_Date-of-Manufacture_Serial-Number-Nomenclature.png, held for the image pass, so year-only. The page's style-2 description text repeats the style-1 wording, but the marked example 12-07A-012064 and the stated positions are unambiguous. Pattern is disjoint from style 1 (11 vs 10 characters).
